title: Aggregator mashes unrelated items into one page
description: A low-quality aggregation page mixes several unrelated items. The page must not spawn multiple events or be treated as authoritative.

provenance.note: Synthetic edge case using reserved .test domains. Entities and facts are fictional; designed from real-world failure modes observed during v1 review (rumor/confirmation, corrections, false merges, mutating pages). Not real reporting.
